stem: What is the thesis of the excerpt from “Music and the Maestro”?

options.label: A
options.text: Morgan believed it is important to publicly recognize other people’s talents as performers and mentors.

options.label: B
options.text: Morgan was an accomplished musician who shared his talents by teaching others.

options.label: C
options.text: Morgan’s MUSE program changed the way that many schools approach music education.

options.label: D
options.text: Morgan’s work in local schools inspired others to work on meeting the needs of their communities.
